sources.entry: ScreenToLayers - Easily export your screen into a layered PSD file. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/duyquoc/ScreenToLayers) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/screentolayers/id1077317077?platform=mac)
ScreenToLayers for macOS - ScreenToLayers is a macOS application to easily capture your screen as a layered PSD file.

summary.one_liner: ScreenToLayers is an open-source macOS app that captures the screen into a layered PSD file.
summary.what_it_does: The app captures the user's screen and saves it as a layered Photoshop (PSD) file. The README describes it as a simple tool that meets the author's own needs, and it is written as an open-source alternative to an older app called ScreenShot PSD, which the author says was not optimized for El Capitan and lacked Retina support. The README says the project uses some lesser-known macOS APIs, including for registering a login item and maintaining persistent file access under App Store sandboxing. The author invites bug reports, issues, and pull requests on the dev branch. The README does not list specific features beyond the core screen-to-PSD capture.
use_cases: make editable screenshots for design review
learn macOS sandbox file access and login item APIs
notable: Exports a screen capture as a layered PSD file
Written as an alternative to ScreenShot PSD with Retina support
Demonstrates less-known APIs for launch-at-startup and sandboxed persistent file access
Also distributed free on the Mac App Store
caveats: README says it was built and tested with Xcode 7 on macOS Sierra and requires macOS 10.10, so it may need updates for newer systems
Author describes the feature set as very simple and limited to personal needs
Codebase is Objective-C and the author asks contributors not to mix in Swift
